title: Investigation of genotype-phenotype correlations in patients with neurofibromatosis type I using three-dimensional shape analysis
summary: The project integrates modern imaging techniques such as MRI, 3D photography and intraoral scans to improve the treatment of patients with neurofibromatosis type 1 (NF1). The researchers use artificial intelligence (AI) to: Analyse facial asymmetries, detect typical NF1 patterns and make predictions about growth. This helps orthodontists to develop customised treatments for NF1 patients and thus improve their quality of life in the long term.

interventions.name: Patients with diagnosed NF1 requiring orthodontic treatment
Patients with diagnosed NF1 requiring no for orthodontic treatment
Patients without NF1 requiring orthodontic treatment

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
- Genetic detection of NF1
- Patient/guardian consent to the study
- Participation in no other study
Exclusion criteria:
- Patient wishes exclusion
- Patient does not attend the check-up appointments
